claims: Cricket is a bat-and-ball sport.
Cricket is played between two teams of eleven players.
Cricket is played on an oval field.
Cricket features a central 22-yard pitch with wickets at both ends.
The primary goal in cricket is to score more runs than the opposition by batting, bowling, and fielding.
Cricket is primarily played in Test, One Day International (ODI), and Twenty20 formats.
The batting team aims to score runs.
The bowling team attempts to take 10 wickets to end the innings.
Batters score runs by hitting the ball and running between wickets.
Batters score runs by hitting the ball to the boundary.
Bowlers aim to dismiss batters by hitting the stumps (bowled).
Bowlers aim to dismiss batters by catching a hit ball (caught).
Bowlers aim to dismiss batters by leg-before-wicket (LBW).
Cricket games are played in innings.
Teams alternate batting and bowling.
Test Matches are the longest format.
Test Matches are played over five days.
Test Matches are traditionally considered the ultimate test of skill.
One Day Internationals (ODIs) are played over a single day.
One Day Internationals (ODIs) have a 50-over limit per side.
Twenty20 Internationals (T20I) are restricted to 20 overs per side.
A hard, cork-and-leather ball is used.
The ball can vary in color (red for Tests, white for limited-overs).
The 22-yard pitch is a specialized surface where the bowler delivers the ball to the batter.
There is a distinct, unrelated entity known as "Cricket Wireless".
Cricket Wireless provides prepaid cell phone services.
